profile.name: Elena Vance
profile.bio: Product design lead splitting time between studio critiques, client dinners, and weekend travel. I prefer architectural minimalism, tactile natural fibers, and pieces that transition seamlessly from day to evening.
profile.stylingGoals: Effortless architectural tailoring for work and travel.

blueprint.summary: Your warm undertone and balanced frame shine in clean architectural silhouettes with deliberate tonal contrast. Natural matte fabrics with crisp shoulder structure anchor your modern minimalist aesthetic.
idealSilhouettes: High-rise pleated trousers with tucked or cropped knits
Longline structured overcoats worn open for verticality
Clean straight-leg raw denim balanced with refined footwear
proportionTips: Define the waistline slightly above natural hip to emphasize a 1/3 to 2/3 leg ratio.
Pair heavier outer coats with fine-gauge base knits to keep shoulders sharp.

rankedCombinations.title: Camel Overcoat over Ivory & Charcoal
rankedCombinations.rationale: Pairs Ivory Fine-Gauge Merino Crewneck with Charcoal Double-Pleat Wool Trousers, finished with Camel Double-Breasted Overcoat and Espresso Calfskin Penny Loafers for cohesive smart casual polish.
rankedCombinations.fabricFitNotes: Contrasts Extra-fine Italian merino wool, High-twist worsted tropical wool, Brushed camel wool twill with crisp silhouette balance and clean tonal separation.
rankedCombinations.bodyTailoringNote: Aligned with your Balanced Athletic frame and preference for tailored proportions.
rankedCombinations.finishingTouch: Leave the outer layer unbuttoned to create a clean vertical line.

advisorMessages.content:
Welcome to your styling studio, Elena. I have indexed all 6 pieces in your wardrobe along with their fabric weights, silhouettes, and image vectors.

Your foundation of Camel Overcoat, Charcoal Pleated Trousers, and Espresso Loafers is exceptionally cohesive. Whenever you want trend updates, gap-filling purchase ideas, or advice on whether a new item fits your closet, just ask.
